dispositions.muse-premature-shutdown: Reproduced and fixed: defer cleanup until actual app quit; installer refusal leaves services running.
dispositions.muse-unrelated-quit: Reproduced and fixed: listen to native update signal and refuse installation once ordinary quit cleanup starts.
dispositions.muse-fixed-timeout: Recorded existing limitation, not a cancellation promise: the existing observation deadline can precede a late native install. No platform cancellation or force-exit policy is invented.
dispositions.muse-fixed-cleanup-hang: Existing unbounded service shutdown can block quitting both before and after this patch. Not counted as fixed; no unsupported claim of complete installation after the start signal.
dispositions.grok-parent-ownership: Reproduced and fixed: forks relinquish parent ownership of shared buckets.
dispositions.grok-batch-atomicity: Not adopted. Batch processing intentionally isolates malformed events and preserves valid deltas, as existing regressions assert. Production batches contain only consecutive deltas separated by snapshot/lifecycle barriers. onResult failures are observer/handler errors after a valid reduction, not an instruction to discard streamed data. The proposed all-or-nothing/rollback behavior would lose valid deltas and is not the implemented contract.
